messages:
ashley: quick design check — scorecard CTAs on the eval-run page feel ambiguous to reviewers. we currently have "Approve" and "Resolve" but folks are confused whether they are signing off on the entire prompt set or just the single test. cc @matt @vikram :thinking_face:

matt: big +1. on runs we need a clear distinction: approving a single test vs signing off on the whole run/prompt set. i worry people will click the wrong thing during automation QA runs.

vikram: what about using 'Sign off' for the entire prompt set and 'Resolve' for individual tests? 'Sign off' makes intent explicit.

ashley: sounds reasonable. accessibility and copy nits: @sara — can you confirm contrast and screenreader expectations for the primary CTA?

sara: quick a11y check: primary CTA color ratio is currently ~3.2:1 at small label size — fails AA. also in compact scorecard mode the icon-only buttons lack aria-labels. we should: 1) bump contrast to 4.5:1 for small text, 2) add aria-labels to icon buttons, 3) ensure focus order for diff toggles.

ashley: thanks. i'll propose copy options and a small color tweak. quick poll (react with emoji): 1️⃣ 'Sign off' / 'Resolve' 2️⃣ 'Approve' / 'Approve test' 3️⃣ 'Mark reviewed' / 'Mark resolved'

matt: :one: prefer clearer separation.

vikram: :one: as well.

ashley: noted. eval-bot, can you run a quick contrast scan on the current build?

eval-bot: Automated check — scan results for eval-run scorecard UI:
- primary button (current): foreground #2b6cb0 on bg #ffffff -> contrast 3.2:1
- recommended alt: foreground #123e66 on bg #ffffff -> contrast 5.1:1
- missing aria-labels: compact-mode toggle, history expand button

sara: thanks @eval-bot — that recommended alt looks good. also add `aria-pressed` on the diff toggle so screenreaders announce state.

ashley: small interaction detail: when reviewer signs off we should show a lightweight confirmation but avoid implying we changed the model or dataset. suggested modal copy: "Confirm sign-off
This will mark the run as reviewed and record your decision. No model changes will be made." any objections?

vikram: tiny nit: change "mark the run as reviewed" -> "record your review decision" (less ambiguous).

matt: can we include an optional notes field during sign-off? product asked for inline reviewer notes mapping to the approval so it's auditable.

ashley: yep — i propose an optional textarea placeholder: "Explain what you looked for (optional)". not required.

sara: keyboard/accessibility: ensure the modal receives focus on open and the submit button is reachable with keyboard-only flow. also announce the modal with role="dialog" and aria-labelledby.

matt: UX question: do we show approval state on the run list (so PMs can quickly see pending signoffs)? i'd vote yes — add a small pill with count.

ashley: i'll add a run-list pill: "Pending signoffs (3)" that links to the run. also add a tooltip explaining what signoff means.

vikram: implementation note: avoid expensive re-rendering of diff preview when toggling compact mode. use virtualization; we should add an opt-in lazy-load for images/snapshots.

ashley: action items:
- ashley: update mocks with 'Sign off' / 'Resolve' labels, add modal copy tweak and notes field, swap primary color to #123e66, add tooltip and run-list pill. will push prototype by EOD.
- sara: run a11y checklist on the prototype (contrast + aria + focus) and drop fixes in the PR.
- vikram: review perf implications for diff toggle and propose lazy-load approach.
- matt: confirm product acceptance criteria for auditability (logs, who signed, notes).

ashley: thanks all! i'll tag @design and @eng when i push the prototype. :rocket:

matt: thanks — sounds good.

sara: will review accessibility notes after prototype is up. :eyes:
